g.text: Cryogenian Snowball Earth, Adelaide Rift Complex
岩 性 描 述
Red-brown silty dolomite, stromatolitic — pre-Sturtian cap
Diamictite, dropstones, glacial striated clasts — Sturtian glaciation
Black shale, Mn-carbonate layers — post-Sturtian cap
Cap dolostone, tepee structures — post-Marinoan cap
Cryogenian Snowball Earth, Adelaide Rift Complex | 总厚 620m | 7 层 | 比例尺 1:2,440
